description_en: Queries the list of scan targets for AI Red Teaming. This operation supports multi-dimensional filtering and sorting
description_zh: AI Red Teaming，获取扫描目标列表，支持多维度筛选和排序
name: ListAttackTargets

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from 1. Values less than 1 are normalized to 1
parameters.help_zh: 页码，从 1 开始；小于 1 时归一为 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100. Values greater than 100 are clamped to 100. Values less than 1 return HTTP status code 400
parameters.help_zh: 每页条数，默认 10，单页上限 100；大于 100 时钳制为 100，小于 1 时返回 400
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: Filters targets by name using fuzzy match (substring match). If this parameter is not specified, all targets are returned
parameters.help_zh: 按目标名称模糊过滤（包含子串即命中），不传返回全部
parameters.name: target_name

parameters.help_en: Filters targets by the exact business label of the model or agent provider. This parameter is decoupled from ConnectionMethod (technical protocol)
parameters.help_zh: 按模型/Agent 提供商业务标签精确过滤；与 ConnectionMethod（技术协议）解耦
parameters.name: provider

parameters.help_en: Filters targets by the status of the most recent scan task
parameters.help_zh: 按最近一次扫描任务的检测状态过滤
parameters.name: last_scan_status

parameters.help_en: Filters targets by the exact scan target type
parameters.help_zh: 按扫描目标类型精确过滤
parameters.name: target_type

parameters.help_en: Filters targets by the risk level derived from the most recent completed scan task. Targets that have never been scanned do not have a risk level and are not matched by any value
parameters.help_zh: 按最近一次已完成扫描任务派生的风险等级过滤；从未扫描的目标无风险等级，不会被任何取值命中
parameters.name: risk_level

parameters.help_en: The field used for sorting. Only the following three aggregate fields are supported. Sorting is performed in memory. If this parameter is not specified, no additional sorting is applied
parameters.help_zh: 排序字段，仅支持以下三个聚合字段，排序在内存中完成；不传则不额外排序
parameters.name: sort_field

parameters.help_en: The sort order. Targets with null aggregate values are always placed last regardless of the sort order
parameters.help_zh: 排序方向；聚合值为空的目标无论方向都排在最后
parameters.name: sort_order

parameters.help_en: The lower bound (inclusive) of the first scan time range. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 首次扫描时间范围下界（含），毫秒时间戳（Unix epoch 毫秒）
parameters.name: first_scan_time_start

parameters.help_en: The upper bound (inclusive) of the first scan time range. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 首次扫描时间范围上界（含），毫秒时间戳（Unix epoch 毫秒）
parameters.name: first_scan_time_end

parameters.help_en: The lower bound (inclusive) of the last scan time range. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 最后扫描时间范围下界（含），毫秒时间戳（Unix epoch 毫秒）
parameters.name: last_scan_time_start

parameters.help_en: The upper bound (inclusive) of the last scan time range. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 最后扫描时间范围上界（含），毫秒时间戳（Unix epoch 毫秒）
parameters.name: last_scan_time_end

Data.description_en: The list of scan targets on the current page
Data.description_zh: 当前页的扫描目标列表

ConnectionConfig.description_en: The advanced connection configuration for the target (JSON character string). For common fields and provider configuration templates, see the ConnectionConfig parameter description of the CreateAttackTarget operation
ConnectionConfig.description_zh: 目标连接高级配置（JSON 字符串），常见字段与 provider 配置模板参见 CreateAttackTarget 的 ConnectionConfig 参数说明

ConnectionMethod.description_en: The connection protocol type of the target service
ConnectionMethod.description_zh: 目标服务的连接协议类型

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the target was created. The value is a millisecond-level UNIX timestamp
CreateTime.description_zh: 目标创建时间，毫秒时间戳（Unix epoch 毫秒）

Description.description_en: The description of the scan target
Description.description_zh: 扫描目标的用途备注说明

Endpoint.description_en: The HTTP or HTTPS endpoint address of the target model service
Endpoint.description_zh: 目标模型服务的 HTTP/HTTPS 端点地址

FirstScanTime.description_en: The time when the first scan was performed. The value is a millisecond-level UNIX timestamp. This parameter is null if no scan has been performed
FirstScanTime.description_zh: 首次扫描时间，毫秒时间戳（Unix epoch 毫秒）；从未扫描时为 null

LastScanFailMessage.description_en: The failure reason of the most recent scan task. This parameter is empty if the most recent scan did not fail
LastScanFailMessage.description_zh: 最近一次扫描任务的失败原因；最近一次扫描未失败时为空

LastScanStatus.description_en: The detection status of the most recent scan task
LastScanStatus.description_zh: 最近一次扫描任务的检测状态

LastScanTime.description_en: The time when the last scan was performed. The value is a millisecond-level UNIX timestamp. This parameter is null if no scan has been performed
LastScanTime.description_zh: 最后扫描时间，毫秒时间戳（Unix epoch 毫秒）；从未扫描时为 null

LastVerifyMessage.description_en: The detailed message of the most recent connectivity verification. If the verification succeeded, the value is a response content snippet returned by the target service. If the verification failed, the value is the error reason
LastVerifyMessage.description_zh: 最近一次连通性验证的详细消息；验证通过时为目标服务返回的响应内容片段，失败时为错误原因

ModelName.description_en: The name of the target model

ModifyTime.description_en: The time when the target was last modified. The value is a millisecond-level UNIX timestamp
ModifyTime.description_zh: 目标最后修改时间，毫秒时间戳（Unix epoch 毫秒）

Provider.description_en: The business label of the model or agent provider
Provider.description_zh: 模型/Agent 提供商业务标签

RiskLevel.description_en: The risk level derived from the most recent completed scan task. This parameter is null if no scan has been performed
RiskLevel.description_zh: 最近一次已完成扫描任务派生的风险等级；从未扫描时为 null

ScanCount.description_en: The total number of scans performed. The value is 0 if no scan has been performed
ScanCount.description_zh: 累计扫描次数；从未扫描时为 0

TargetId.description_en: The unique identifier of the scan target

TargetName.description_en: The display name of the scan target

TargetType.description_en: The type of the scan target

VerifyStatus.description_en: The connectivity verification status of the target
VerifyStatus.description_zh: 目标的连通性验证状态

PageNumber.description_en: The normalized page number that takes effect. The value may differ from the input parameter
PageNumber.description_zh: 归一化后的实际生效页码，不一定等于入参

PageSize.description_en: The normalized number of entries per page that takes effect. The value may differ from the input parameter
PageSize.description_zh: 归一化后的实际生效每页条数，不一定等于入参

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. You can use this ID for troubleshooting and log tracing
RequestId.description_zh: 本次请求的唯一标识，用于问题排查与日志追踪

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of scan targets that match the filter conditions. In post-filtering scenarios, this value is the total count after in-memory filtering
TotalCount.description_zh: 满足过滤条件的扫描目标总数；后置过滤场景为内存过滤后的总数
